items.title: GTA 5 Launched on PS3. GTA 6 Is for PS5 🎮
items.description:
GTA 5 launched on PlayStation 3 in 2013. GTA 6 comes out November 19, 2026, on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S.

The longest gap between GTA games before this was about 5.4 years (GTA IV, April 29, 2008, to GTA 5, September 17, 2013). GTA 5 to GTA 6 is more than double that.

The date moved twice:
- First target: fall 2025 (Take-Two, February 2025)
- Delay 1: announced May 2, 2025, new date May 26, 2026
- Delay 2: announced November 6, 2025, new date November 19, 2026

Sources: rockstargames.com/VI and the launch trailer's end card (October 15, 2026), Rockstar's statements as reported by VGC (May 2, 2025) and Variety (November 7, 2025), rockstarnorth.com for the GTA 5 date. The year counts are our own arithmetic from those release dates.

Made with our own graphics. No Rockstar footage. Not affiliated with Rockstar Games or Take-Two.
